note: The pathological replay: every window answers at the cap, including after the planner has narrowed to a single day. This is the ONLY shape that may still record `partial`, and it exists so that `partial` remains reachable — a status nothing can ever produce is not a status. Paired in test/runner.test.ts with a 2-day plan and `cap: 150`, so the recorded 150-row shard stands in for 'at cap' and the whole case costs three fetches; the real 1000-row cap is exercised against livewhale-events.json in test/shard.test.ts.
